periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high aspect ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point displaced medially from the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature at the posterior boundary where the black pigment meets the white lumbar fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso section from the base of the neck to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the superior-lateral margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, prominent reddish-brown lesion or area of significant fur staining and potential skin exposure on the lateral aspect of the right hind limb.
other_distinctive_markers: Open oral cavity exposing dentition and tongue; right forepaw is elevated with visible claws.
